newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel says 3.8 mln shares tendered.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel says 3.8 mln shares tendered.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Tuesday that some 3,763,957 shares were tendered at or below $15 per share in response to a Dutch Auction tender offer which expired March 24, 1997.
Titan Wheel said it began the tender offer on February 25 and announced its intention to purchase up to five million shares at a range of $12.50 to $15 per share.

The shares expected to be purchased represent about 15 percent of the 25.5 million shares of stock outstanding immediately prior to the offer. After purchasing the shares, Titan will have about 21.7 million shares outstanding.
The company said its directors believe the purchase of the shares at this time is consistent with its long term goal to increase shareholder value.
The determination of the actual number of shares to be purchased and the purchase price are subject to final confirmation.
Titan Wheel supplies mounted tire and wheel systems for off-highway equipment used in agriculture, construction, mining, military, recreation and grounds care.
Shares of Titan Wheel were trading up 1/8 to 14-3/4.
